description: This file contains an extension of the `OnboardingView` class, adding a method `maybeKickoffOnboardingChat` that conditionally initiates a chat onboarding sequence for new users, including delayed message checks and setting an initial message.

classes.name: OnboardingView
classes.description: The class extended by this Swift extension, responsible for managing user onboarding flow.

methods.name: maybeKickoffOnboardingChat
methods.description: Checks several conditions to determine whether to automatically start a chat onboarding sequence, initiates a waiting loop for the chat model to load, and sets an initial message to begin onboarding.
